latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release with AI video generation from text prompts.

- Generate 1080p MP4 videos from text, scripts, or document files (TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT up to 500MB).
- Cloud rendering with output typically ready in 1–2 minutes; supports batch and iterative editing.
- Seamless setup with anonymous token and session creation for immediate use.
- Supports export, file upload, video state queries, and balance checking.
- Includes error handling, workflow tips, and streamlined request headers for all API actions.
